# Vercel AI SDK — knowledge skill for building AI features (short listing)

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the discovery manifest records NOASSERTION — the manifest makes faith, so no content is reproduced): @midudev's ai-sdk skill (part of the autoskills registry), a knowledge skill for answering questions about the Vercel AI SDK and helping build AI features. Its core rule: do not trust internal knowledge — the SDK moves fast, so the agent always verifies against the bundled docs and source in node_modules/ai/ (or ai-sdk.dev for earlier versions), checks the common-errors reference before writing client code, fetches current model IDs from the AI Gateway instead of memory, runs typecheck after changes, and stays minimal. It covers agent creation with the ToolLoopAgent pattern, type-safe agents with useChat (InferAgentUIMessage), framework-specific consumption patterns, and references (common errors, AI Gateway, type-safe agents, DevTools).
